why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the Spark app Go to the Spark app , where the homepage announces Season 4 SPK claiming and lists the savings accounts.
2 Step 2 : Check the eligible vaults Open the Points page to see which savings vaults currently earn Spark Points and the campaign details.

3 Step 3 : Earn Spark Points in an eligible vault The docs state that selected savings vaults earn Spark Points, and Spark has not said how Points relate to Season 4 SPK. To deposit, connect a wallet and use one of the vaults on the Savings page ; the deposit and withdraw guide walks through the process.
4 Step 4 : Claim Season 4 SPK on the Points page If your wallet has Season 4 SPK, claim it on the Points page . Spark has not stated who qualifies or when claiming closes.
